analytical_derivation_contracts.title: Crespo TODOSNAVIOS record aggregation per place and period preset
analytical_derivation_contracts.derivation_method: Relational aggregation on raw_todosnavios filtered by date ranges and mapped Lugar IDs
analytical_derivation_contracts.verification_invariant: Baseline total matches 1,928 scoped records (1650–1730); exact counts match per place; accepted by Packet 7 external review.

analytical_derivation_contracts.title: Endpoint role classification (departure vs arrival)
analytical_derivation_contracts.derivation_method: Counting voyage occurrences as origin (records_with_origin) versus destination (records_with_destination)
analytical_derivation_contracts.verification_invariant: Non-negative integers for records_with_origin and records_with_destination; accepted by Packet 7 external review.

analytical_derivation_contracts.title: Dual-endpoint overlap and union arithmetic
analytical_derivation_contracts.derivation_method: Set intersection of origin and destination within single voyage record (both_endpoint_records)
analytical_derivation_contracts.verification_invariant: total_records == records_with_origin + records_with_destination - both_endpoint_records; Cádiz overlap = 24 records; accepted by Packet 7 external review.

analytical_derivation_contracts.title: Directed counterpart pair ranking with self-counterpart exclusion
analytical_derivation_contracts.derivation_method: Frequency ranking of opposite-endpoint Lugar IDs strictly excluding the examined place's own Lugar ID with stable deterministic tie-breaking
analytical_derivation_contracts.verification_invariant: Examined place never appears in its own top_counterparts list; deterministic ordering on ties (record count desc, source label asc, ID asc); accepted by Packet 7 external review.

analytical_derivation_contracts.title: Canonical place mapping lookup and unmapped sentinel handling
analytical_derivation_contracts.derivation_method: Explicit YAML lookup with 19 mapped and 10 unmapped places; source-row verification confirmed via deterministic local mirror audit; 19 editorial place resolutions and 10 unmapped sentinels accepted by Packet 7 external review
analytical_derivation_contracts.verification_invariant: Audit confirms exactly 19 mapped, 10 unmapped places; unmapped places have periods: null; no synthetic zeroes; Saint-Domingue remains unmapped; accepted by Packet 7 external review.

place_mapping_review.source_qa_summary: All 19 mapped native Crespo LUGARES IDs verified against raw DuckDB tables with 0 label mismatches and 0 workstation leaks.
place_mapping_review.editorial_resolution_summary: 19 canonical place linkages and 10 unmapped sentinels accepted by external review. Saint-Domingue remains explicitly unmapped.
